name: product_codes
comment: Cross-reference mapping each channel's own product code/name onto the canonical product_id, so every channel's raw orders can be joined to item_master.

columns.name: hash_key
columns.comment: Deterministic hash of this record's natural/business key, generated during ingestion. Used internally for deduplication and change-detection; not a business attribute and should not be used for reporting.

columns.name: product_id
columns.comment: Canonical product/SKU identifier this source code maps to. Joins to item_master.

columns.name: channel_code
columns.comment: Sales channel this code mapping applies to.

columns.name: source_code
columns.comment: The channel's own native product/item/SKU code (e.g. item_code, marketplace_sku, stock_code) prior to mapping.

columns.name: source_product_name
columns.comment: The channel's own native product name/title prior to mapping.

columns.name: insert_timestamp
columns.comment: UTC timestamp when this record was first loaded into the silver layer. Reflects pipeline load time, not a business event time.

columns.name: modified_timestamp
columns.comment: UTC timestamp when this record was last updated by the ingestion pipeline. Reflects pipeline processing time, not a business event time.

columns.name: source_name
columns.comment: Name of the upstream source system or source file this record was ingested from. Used for data lineage and troubleshooting, not for business analysis.

columns.name: is_deleted
columns.comment: Soft-delete flag set by the ingestion pipeline when the source record was removed or tombstoned upstream. Rows where this is TRUE should normally be excluded from business reporting.
